title: Sprint 2 — Style the Restaurant Page (HTML + CSS)
description: Take the restaurant page you built in Sprint 1 and make it look stunning. You will style every section using modern CSS — custom properties, Flexbox, Grid, hover transitions, and a fully responsive mobile layout. By the end, your page will look like a real professional website.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Design System: Variables, Reset & Typography
tickets.description: Before writing any visible styles, build the foundation. Create a CSS design system using custom properties so that every colour, font, spacing value, and shadow on the page can be changed from one place.

tasks.title: Task 1 — CSS Reset & Custom Properties
tasks.description:
In your `style.css`, do the following:
1. Add a universal reset: `*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }`
2. Define CSS custom properties in `:root` for at least:
   - `--color-primary` (e.g. a warm red or terracotta)
   - `--color-bg` (page background)
   - `--color-text` (main text)
   - `--color-accent` (a highlight color)
   - `--font-main` (body font family)
   - `--font-heading` (heading font family)
   - `--spacing-sm`, `--spacing-md`, `--spacing-lg`
3. Set `font-family`, `background-color`, and `color` on `body` using your variables.

tasks.title: Task 2 — Typography & Heading Styles
tasks.description:
Style all headings and body text so the page has clear visual hierarchy:
- `h1` should be large (at least 2.5rem) and use `var(--font-heading)`
- `h2` should be clearly smaller than `h1`
- `h3` should be smaller again with a different colour or weight
- `p` should have comfortable `line-height` (at least 1.6) and use `var(--font-main)`
- Add a Google Font import in `<head>` of your HTML and reference it in your variables

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Header, Nav & Hero Styling
tickets.description: Make the first impression count. Style the header with a sticky navigation bar and a visually impressive hero section with a background image and overlay.

tasks.title: Task 1 — Sticky Nav with Flexbox
tasks.description:
Style the `<header>` and `<nav>` using Flexbox:
- The header should stick to the top on scroll (`position: sticky; top: 0`)
- Use Flexbox to place the restaurant name on the left and nav links on the right (`justify-content: space-between`)
- Nav links should be horizontal (inline), have `text-decoration: none`, and show a colour change on `:hover` using `transition`
- Add a subtle `box-shadow` to the header

tasks.title: Task 2 — Hero Section with Background & Overlay
tasks.description:
Style the `#hero` section to be visually striking:
- Set a `background-image` (use a food/restaurant URL or `linear-gradient`)
- Add a dark semi-transparent overlay using a `::before` pseudo-element or layered gradient
- Center the text with Flexbox (`display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center`)
- The hero should be at least `70vh` tall
- The `h2` text should be white, large, and readable against the background

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Menu Grid, Table & Card Styles
tickets.description: Style the core menu section. Use CSS Grid to lay out the menu articles side by side, and style the mains table to look polished with alternating row colours and hover effects.

tasks.title: Task 1 — Menu Articles Grid Layout
tasks.description:
Wrap the three menu `<article>` elements in a container and use CSS Grid:
- Desktop: `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr` (3 columns side by side)
- Add a `gap` between cards
- Each article should look like a card — `background`, `border-radius`, `padding`, and a subtle `box-shadow`
- List items should have bottom borders or spacing between them

tasks.title: Task 2 — Styled Table & Hover Row Effects
tasks.description:
Style the `<table>` in the mains article:
- Full width (`width: 100%`)
- `border-collapse: collapse` to remove double borders
- Alternating row background colours using `tr:nth-child(even)`
- `<th>` cells should have a coloured background (`var(--color-primary)`) with white text
- Rows should change background on `tr:hover` using `transition`
- All cells should have padding

tickets.title: Ticket 4 — Form Styles, Footer & Responsive Layout
tickets.description: Finish the full page styling. Make the contact form look professional, create a styled footer, and add a fully responsive mobile layout using media queries so the page works beautifully on any screen size.

tasks.title: Task 1 — Form & Footer Styles
tasks.description:
Style the reservation form:
- `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap` for the form layout
- All `input`, `textarea` should have: `border`, `border-radius`, `padding`, `width: 100%`, and a `:focus` outline using `var(--color-primary)`
- `label` should appear above each input
- The submit `<button>` should have a bold, coloured background, white text, `border: none`, `border-radius`, `padding`, and a hover effect that darkens or scales it

Also add a `<footer>` with `background`, centred text, and copyright info.

tasks.title: Task 2 — Responsive Mobile Layout
tasks.description:
Make the entire page responsive with media queries:
- At `max-width: 768px`:
  - The menu grid should become a single column (`grid-template-columns: 1fr`)
  - The sticky nav links should wrap vertically or be hidden behind a hamburger structure in HTML
  - The hero `h2` should be smaller
  - Table should scroll horizontally (`overflow-x: auto` on a wrapper)
- Test that no content overflows on mobile
